profile_text.body:
NXAI is a frontier AI lab founded in 2023 and based in Linz, Austria. The company describes itself as "Minds for Machines" and focuses on building systems that master cognitive tasks. Its core technology is a proprietary xLSTM memory architecture that the company claims outperforms Transformer architectures. Chief Scientist and co-founder Prof. Dr. Sepp Hochreiter is described as one of the fathers of modern deep learning.

NXAI's current products center on specialized world models built on time-series analysis, marketed under the name TiRex. The company states these models deliver "50× impact across industrial systems" and are deployed in edge, embedded, and forecasting applications. According to its site, the xLSTM architecture spans applications from time series and natural language to robotics and biosciences, with emphasis on higher accuracy, faster inference, and lower operational costs.

The company operates an edge lab and deploys xLSTM models in cloud environments while focusing on edge deployment. NXAI works closely with JKU Linz and other research institutions. The company reports holding top positions in globally recognized leaderboards and emphasizes performance and efficiency as driving forces behind its models.
